verdict.rationale: Requesty is a pure API gateway, so it runs headlessly by design. Its OpenAI-compatible endpoint works by swapping the base_url, and clients like Claude Code connect through environment variables only. Service accounts provide non-human credentials whose spend is not tied to a user, with per-key monthly spend caps suited to automation. Missing for 10: an explicit CI/pipeline integration guide or examples, a first-party CLI, a published OpenAPI spec (probe found none), and independent hands-on corroboration.
